subject: Decision Making
title: AI Makes Decisions
description: A short lesson to help you apply AI Makes Decisions.

hook.text: In 2016, Google's AlphaGo beat the world champion at Go. The AI made moves no human had ever considered.

buildup.text: Go has more possible positions than atoms in the universe. Brute force cannot solve it. AlphaGo learned by playing.

discovery.text: Move 37 in game two stunned experts. It looked wrong. It won the game. AI found strategies humans could not imagine.

twist.text: The AI cannot explain why move 37 was good. Its decisions are effective but opaque. We trust without understanding.

climax.text: AI decisions are powerful but uninterpretable. The next frontier is making machine choices explainable to humans.

punchline.text: Move 37 won the game. Nobody knows why. AI decides without explaining.

quiz.question: What is the main challenge with AI decision-making?
options: AI decisions are effective but often cannot be explained
